description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/mpas/rules/fv_divergence_cell — the unstructured-grid exemplar: connectivity-based stencil via the ragged edges_of_cell index set instead of makearray regions. Every binding loads fixture.esm (metaparameters folded at the import edge to the level-0 mesh sizes), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST for the model: div(flux) replaced by the ragged finite-volume aggregate (output over cells, contracted k over edges_of_cell with the nEdgesOnCell/edgesOnCell offsets/values factors), zero apply_expression_template nodes, zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, and zero surviving metaparameter names. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
